fallen_home = {
	usage = fallen_empire_init
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	flags = { ancient_wonders_system }
	init_effect = {
		set_star_flag = fixture_beacon
	}
	planet = {
		count = 1
		class = star
		init_effect = {
			create_country = {
				name = "NAME_Fixture_Fallen"
				type = fallen_empire
				flag = {
					icon = { category = "synthetic" file = "flag_synthetic_2.dds" }
					colors = { "fixture_navy" "fixture_navy" "null" "null" }
				}
				effect = {
					save_global_event_target_as = fixture_fallen
				}
			}
			set_owner = event_target:fixture_fallen
		}
	}
	neighbor_system = {
		distance = { min = 0 max = 50 }
		initializer = "fallen_colony"
	}
}

fallen_colony = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	spawn_system = {
		min_distance >= 10
		max_distance <= 30
		initializer = fallen_outpost
	}
}

fallen_outpost = {
	class = sc_sun
}

trader_init = {
	class = sc_sun
	usage = misc_system_init
	flags = { enclave }
	init_effect = {
		create_country = {
			name = {
				key = "NAME_Traders"
				variable_string = "[Root.GetName]"
			}
			type = enclave
		}
	}
}
